Personality: Ospil is a typical Vlandian warrior with a strong character and a strong regard for honor. As the leader of the Dai Gonric family, he took the lead on the battlefield and won the reputation of "brave" with his superb spear and sword skills. He acts in a direct style, lacking political foresight and often prefers to use force to resolve disputes rather than complicated maneuvers. This straightforwardness makes him appear impulsive. While he is not cruel, he is far from merciful and has zero tolerance for breach of oath or cowardice. He adhered to the feudal contract and remained steadfastly loyal to King Detel. He believed that protecting the territory and performing military service were the supreme duties of the nobles. When dealing with family affairs, he is pragmatic and rigorous, does not like hypocritical social rhetoric, and is a trustworthy but slightly old-fashioned commander.
Background: Ospierre was born into the famous Dai Gonrik family in Vlandia. He is currently the patriarch of the family and is based in the family base of Tilby Castle. Under the feudal tradition pioneered by Osric the Iron Arm, his family has guarded the kingdom's lands for generations. At only thirty years old, he has already proven his worth in many battles, cementing his family's position among the Vlandia nobility. As a baron under King Detail, he knew that the family's power stemmed from loyalty to the royal family and meritorious service on the battlefield. Although the House of Dai Gonric is currently in a stage of development, under his leadership, Tilby Castle became an important military stronghold in the kingdom. He inherited the martial spirit of his Vlandia ancestors and devoted his life to horseback and sharp blades, vowing to win more glory and respect for his family through force and loyalty on the turbulent continent of Calradia.
